title: On the Experimental Determination of Nonlocal Characteristics of Two-Qubit Gates
summary: In this paper, we discuss the experimental determination of the nonlocal characteristics of two-qubit gates. Based on the recently derived expressions for the entangling power and gate typicality of two-qubit gates, we construct two-qubit quantum circuits to measure the entangling power and gate typicality of the two-qubit gates, which are generated by the elements of the su(4) Cartan subalgebra. These elements describe the native interactions in many quantum processors. Hence, these circuits can be used to determine the nonlocal characteristics of native gates of many quantum processors.
